stories.title: Pakistan, UK express concern at threat posed by terrorist groups operating in and from Afghanistan: FO
stories.brief: Pakistan and the United Kingdom on Wednesday expressed concerns over the ongoing threat from terrorist groups operating in and from Afghanistan, the Foreign Office said.

stories.title: PIA to run 3 weekly direct flights between Islamabad and Birmingham from Dec 1
stories.brief: Pakistan International Airlines (PIA) announced on Wednesday that it is launching three weekly direct flights between Islamabad and Birmingham from Dec 1.
